messages:
Rina (Finance): Heads-up — HelioScale invoice INV-2026-1299 hit returned ACH this morning. It's 52 days past due and they're asking to push 2 installments + request to pause dunning. Details below.
BillingBot: Automated notice: ACH return code R01 for INV-2026-1299. Original due: 2026-03-04. Amount: $62,400. https://billing.redwood.ai/invoices/INV-2026-1299
Sam (Account Exec): I just spoke with their Head of Ops. They had a payroll timing issue after a delayed client payment. Asking for 2 installments: 50% now, 50% in 30 days. They want no service disruption until 1st payment clears — onboarding is live.
Priya (Collections): Default position: require full first installment up front (card on file or cleared ACH) + signed payment schedule. We can offer two installments but need autopay turned on and a conditional late-fee waiver.
Don (Finance Director): We can accept a two-part schedule only if the first payment clears within 3 business days of agreement. No exceptions on autopay. Also, keep standard late fees in force until first payment clears; we can consider waiver refund if cleared timely.
Sam (Account Exec): Customer proposes:
```
INV-2026-1299  Total $62,400
1) $31,200 due on agreement (ASAP)
2) $31,200 due 2026-06-12
Waive late fees (~$1,560) if first payment clears by 2026-05-20 and autopay enabled.
```
Priya (Collections): OK. I'll draft outbound with conditions: authorize card on file OR attempt ACH with positive confirmation, attach payment-plan addendum, state that failure on first installment triggers immediate suspension and late fee reinstatement.
Legal Ops: I'll prepare the standard addendum with suspension/reinstatement language, require CFO signature, and a clause for re-instatement fees. Share me the final schedule and payment method.
Rina (Finance): Please flag invoice in AR as "payment-plan-pending" to stop automated daily dunning emails to the customer thread, but keep internal escalations to collections. We'll set monitoring to re-enable dunning if first payment fails.
BillingBot: Note: recommended manual retry blocked until authorization obtained. Current dunning schedule paused by Collections flag.
Don (Finance Director): Approve conditional two-installment plan provided: 1) first payment clears within 3 business days, autopay/card on file required, 2) late fee refund only after first payment clears by 5/20. If missed, immediate hold + restore fees.
Sam (Account Exec): I'll get confirmation on the call at 11:30 PT and collect card auth. Will post signed addendum here.
Priya (Collections): After Sam confirms, I'll send the email with payment link and addendum. Also scheduling an internal check-in for 5/21 to confirm ledger update and fee refund if applicable.
Rina (Finance): Once cleared, I'll update the AR aging and cash forecast, and mark invoice as on-plan. We should also note this account as high churn risk for Customer Success follow-up.
Sam (Account Exec): Noted — CS will coordinate a health check once payments are stable. Thanks team. :slightly_smiling_face:
